composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap stutter-house beat slices as a waveform fractures and reforms; miss a hit and the track glitches louder until you lock the loop.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: nailing one perfect 16-bar loop feels like dropping a Fred again.. edit live
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs and stutter patterns stack into double-time fragments
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon waveform club visuals under an overcast purple SF sky

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Draw a path through nested folder mazes before a browser picker window snaps shut — each route unlocks a buried file icon.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: every successful route reveals one hidden file before the picker closes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: the picker window shrinks and spawns deeper nested directories
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: OS file-picker UI rebuilt as layered paper cutouts

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Swipe between fog lanes across a Golden Gate silhouette, collecting sunrise light orbs before a shipping-by-sunrise countdown hits zero.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: clearing fog to catch the last golden orb before dawn deadline
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: fog banks merge, lanes narrow, orbs drift faster toward the horizon
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor overcast San Francisco morning with bleeding gold edges

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick encrypted message bubbles into matching key slots before they decay — wrong sorts scramble the bubble into unreadable static.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: completing one message chain unlocks a poetic decrypted fragment
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: more bubble types spawn and decoy keys appear mid-round
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: glass morphism chat bubbles floating on dark linen
